newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cabinet chief backs Econ Min Fernandez.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cabinet chief backs Econ Min Fernandez.

text.p: Argentine Cabinet Chief Jorge Rodriguez late Monday came out in defense of Economy Minister Roque Fernandez, who was dismissed as a "technocrat" Sunday by Buenos Aires Governor Eduardo Duhalde.
Rodriguez told reporters that Fernandez's work was "extraordinary" and "ties in perfectly with the activities of a Peronist government."

On Sunday, Duhalde, the main Peronist presidential hopeful, struck back at Fernandez for opposing his plans to create a new Production Ministry and for suggesting he was engaged in a power struggle with President Carlos Menem.
"I'm not really concerned about Roque Fernandez's opinion because he is not a Peronist," Duhalde said.
But Rodriguez came out backing Fernandez, who earlier this month shed his low profile to criticize Duhalde.
"The country is full of people who support the Peronists because of the reforms they carry out, but who are not necessarily card-carrying party members," Rodriguez said.
"In the cabinet, we all cooperate with President (Carlos) Menem and activity in the area of the economy is constantly reflecting an improvement in social conditions," he added.

Rodriguez noted that over the past year, 518,000 new jobs have been created, "which means there has been a great improvement and also that we have to keep working and not be satisfied with what we've done."
